'''Raphael Mar-Shayal''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rebel pilot/Legends|pilot]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Mar-Shayal hid from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] on the slopes of [[Mount Chaolt]], a [[Volcano/Legends|volcano]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lok/Legends|Lok]]. Mar-Shayal was suspected by then [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Maximilian Veers/Legends|Maximilian Veers]] as being involved in the destruction of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]]. In light of this, Colonel Veers tasked an Imperial operative with tracking down and [[Death/Legends|killing]] Mar-Shayal, alongside two other suspects, [[Aramis Kariya]] and [[Fen Corandel]].

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:FenCorandel.jpg|250px|thumb|Randomly generated depictions of Raphael Mar-Shayal]]
Raphael Mar-Shayal was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:ItDotDS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Raphael Mar-Shayal was added to the game with the revamped "[[W:c:swg:Imperial Theme Park|Imperial Theme Park]],"<ref name="SWG:ItDotDS" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Update Notes 6.12: September 13 2007|Chapter 6.12]]" update, on [[September 13]], [[2007]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 6.12: Masters of the Wild">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67417&month=092007|text=Chapter 6.12: Masters of the Wild}}</ref>
